# DIY Tarp awning tensioning system

## Summary

[Partial] Sleeve a larger piece of PVC over the smaller mounting pole and pre-drill straight lines into it. [t939]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Sleeve a larger piece of PVC over the smaller mounting pole.
2. Pre-drill straight lines into the outer PVC and cut screws short so they bite in without protruding through to the inside.

_Procedure reported by [t939]._
